newsitem.title: USA: CBOT December corn breaks on weather, technicals.
newsitem.headline: CBOT December corn breaks on weather, technicals.

text.p: CBOT December corn futures were sharply lower in fast dealings late as support broke at $3.14-1/2 per bushel and forecasts called for warmer weather in key U.S. Midwest growing regions, traders said.
"We took out the chart point at $3.14-1/2 and that was last year's price," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter Reynolds. "We're now below last year's price."
LIT America reportedly sold six million bushels December and Rosenthal Collins was also a noted seller, traders said.
"On a technical basis, this stuff smells," a trader said. "I don't think you've seen the bottom in corn."
At 1313 CDT, corn was 2-1/4 to eight cents per bushel lower with September down five at $3.56-3/4 and December down eight at $3.13-1/2.
